name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's fascination with aerodynamics began early, sparked by his father's work as an aircraft mechanic. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in fluid dynamics, before landing his first motorsport role with a small Chilean rally team. He quickly demonstrated an aptitude for optimizing vehicle performance through meticulous aero adjustments, often achieving surprising gains on a shoestring budget.

His reputation for resourcefulness and innovative solutions caught the eye of EVO Racing Team. Ricardo believes in a holistic approach to aerodynamics, viewing it as an integral part of the entire vehicle design. He's known for his ability to translate complex data into practical, driver-friendly improvements. His big-picture thinking and dedication to the team make him a valuable asset, even if his methods can sometimes be unconventional.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Insists on personally inspecting the airflow around the car with a handheld anemometer before every race.
Has a habit of muttering aerodynamic principles under his breath when stressed.
